preexisting_protocol_negative_control.conclusion: DO_NOT_USE_P81_SPLIT_SEEDS_FOR_EXTERNAL_SCIENCE_FIRST_USE; preserve historical immutable prior freeze, do not change or rewrite consumed source.
preexisting_protocol_negative_control.real_external_data_so_far: NONE, so all successor seeds unconsumed

frozen_successor.check: Pairwise cross-split seed intersection=0 AND within-split uniqueness AND all 32-bit signed nonnegative seeds
frozen_successor.no_retry: Short episodes, source crashes and uncertain-effect sessions MUST be separately counted and never retried on same seed.
frozen_successor.terminal_rule: Stop on terminated/truncated or 96 actual steps; no synthetic padding.
frozen_successor.manifest: Write immutable prospective source-manifest and signed owner-witness provenance in repo before real first-use. Signed receipt is REQUIRED, self-reported IDs or seed checks not sufficient.
frozen_successor.real_source_permission: NOT_GRANTED by freeze, PR, CI or user phrase 'next gate'; separate project-owned narrowly scoped approval required before any env reset/do or data birth.

upstream_regimes.limitations: These are across-episode held-out wind-regime shifts, NOT unobserved within-episode changepoints. Model does not receive regime/wind labels or hidden exogenous state. Intervention action information and observations must be exactly matched across arms.

frozen_candidate_and_controls.candidate: P78-MR pretrained non_directional3 fixed theta for seeds 978201,978203,978207, from committed P78-MR receipt blob c180bfa8dab735000360ba2e87f51dbe42ec3d89; no re-training or external update of static theta.
frozen_candidate_and_controls.fixed_registered: P78-MR CAL-selected all-write eta=.4 (no external calibration)

controls_required.plan: At least P78 83 fixed predeclared gains, choose strongest on external CAL only, freeze before DEV and OOD
Fully train 256-dimensional persistent recurrent hidden state on FIT only, checkpoint select CAL only, same per-step factual inputs as candidate and same target labels
Fully train 256-dimensional persistent diagonal SSM state on FIT only, checkpoint select CAL only, same information/actions
At most 256 persistent float state, trained on source FIT only; properly conditioned non-leaking state/action features
Ablation reference; not the strongest control

frozen_candidate_and_controls.budget_policy: Precommit conventional capacity, optimizer, update budget and stop rules separately before FIT first-use; require all baselines fully competent and independently qualified before OOD. Current protocol alone is NOT baseline qualification.
frozen_candidate_and_controls.fairness: Disclose full source-generation, training, CAL sweeps, selected checkpoints, memory size, model static weights, wall time, CPU/GPU compute, memory and external data consumption for each arm; memory state capacity alone does not equal whole-process resource parity.

metrics_and_outcomes.primary: Normalized four-channel realized state-delta MSE, scaled by fixed [2.4,3.0,0.2095,3.5] and tanh transform as precommitted in P80; report per channel + aggregate; do not base acceptance on padded 16D MSE.
metrics_and_outcomes.secondary: Observed reward MSE, termination/truncation accuracy with class counts, read-before-write factual timeline, cold restored memory error, disjoint external episode seeds, effect of wind regime shifts.
metrics_and_outcomes.measurement_unit: Per-independent-world average, then across-world paired bootstrap of 5000 resamples, 95pct lower confidence bound on relative error reduction.
metrics_and_outcomes.science_threshold: On each of three OOD regimes and each of three candidate seeds, candidate primary per-world mean MSE <=0.90*best qualified conventional/fixed comparator, stable cold retention no worse than 1.05*, AND pooled paired bootstrap lower relative improvement >0.0; otherwise SCIENTIFIC_PASS=FALSE.
metrics_and_outcomes.negative_controls: Wrong action-credit and time-shifted consequence pairing must degrade vs correct pairing; null source effects and hidden wind labels must not leak into action context.
metrics_and_outcomes.comparison_claims: CartPoleWind uses a fixed 4D physical state and discrete action; P80 mapping is state-conditioned and padded; it is NOT the same 16D action-only synthetic task. No independent general intelligence, RSI or tokenless foundation claim from this evaluation.

stop_rules.source: If source binary SHA mismatch, detached witness missing, duplicate episode seed, previous-source collision, missing raw transition provenance, unsupported task regime or unpredictable state-action execution, STOP before effectful first use.
stop_rules.training: If fully trained conventional baselines not available, or whole-process cost not disclosed, STOP before independent OOD; preserve FIT/CAL/DEV negative results.
stop_rules.cohort: No silent discard or replay of a short/failed/terminated episode; record denominator and reason and stop if >15pct have fewer than 2 events in any cohort; threshold fixed prior to source birth.
stop_rules.post_result: No threshold selection or new metric after seeing dev or OOD data; failed criteria remain FAIL, not unverified success.

execution_authority.allowed_now: Offline deterministic dry-run of seed schedule and schema/manifest validation only; no upstream import, simulation, source generation or inference.
required_before_first_use: fully frozen conventional control training plans
execution_authority.receipts_location: GitHub repo/PR/Actions only, not ChatGPT Library
